# anomaly_schedule (Resource)

Manages a nxs-anomaly on-call schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anomaly_schedule" "weekdays" {
  name     = "Weekdays On-Call"
  timezone = "Europe/Moscow"
  team_id  = anomaly_team.ops.id

  shifts = [
    {
      user_id    = anomaly_user.alice.id
      start_at   = "2026-06-02T09:00:00Z"
      end_at     = "2026-06-02T18:00:00Z"
      recurrence = "weekly"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this schedule participates in on-call resolution.
- `notify_on_shift_change` (Boolean) Notify participants when the active on-call shift changes.
- `rotation` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rotation))
- `shifts` (Attributes List) List of on-call shifts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shifts))
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team that owns this schedule.
- `timezone` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `provisioned_by` (String) Set to "terraform" for objects this provider created. The API then refuses edits from anyone else and the web UI disables its own controls, so an out-of-band change cannot be silently undone by the next apply.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--rotation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rotation`

Required:

- `participant_ids` (List of String)
- `start_at` (String) Rotation start time (RFC3339). The API returns it in the schedule's timezone. After `terraform import`, a value written with another offset shows a one-time in-place update that changes nothing on the server.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `handoff_interval` (Number)
- `handoff_unit` (String)
- `restriction` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rotation--restriction))

<a id="nestedatt--rotation--restriction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rotation.restriction`

Required:

- `end` (String)
- `start` (String)

Optional:

- `days` (List of String)



<a id="nestedatt--shifts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shifts`

Required:

- `end_at` (String) Shift end time (RFC3339). The API returns it in the schedule's timezone. After `terraform import`, a value written with another offset shows a one-time in-place update that changes nothing on the server.
- `start_at` (String) Shift start time (RFC3339). The API returns it in the schedule's timezone. After `terraform import`, a value written with another offset shows a one-time in-place update that changes nothing on the server.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user on duty during this shift.

Optional:

- `id` (String) Shift ID (computed if not provided).
- `recurrence` (String) Recurrence pattern: none, daily, weekly.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace object-id with the existing object identifier.
terraform import anomaly_schedule.weekdays object-id
```
